title: Analyzing Learning-Dynamics Across Loss and Prediction Choices for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Denoising generative models predict clean data ($x$), noise ($\epsilon$), or velocity ($v$), while training losses can be measured in any of these spaces. Although the resulting nine combinations are algebraically related, they can yield substantially different denoising accuracy and sample quality. We disentangle the effects of prediction and loss spaces. For a fixed prediction target, we show that changing the loss space is exactly equivalent to timestep reweighting and provide a heuristic analysis of how this reweighting affects generation quality. We then show that a rank-$m$ linear bottleneck compressing a $D$-dimensional noisy input imposes an irreducible squared-error floor of $D-m$ on noise and velocity prediction, whereas clean-data prediction can exploit low-dimensional data structure. Combining this bound with prediction-dependent error conversion yields distinct necessary conditions on bottleneck capacity. Experiments with U-

translated_abstract: 去噪生成模型可以预测干净数据（$x$）、噪声（$\epsilon$）或速度（$v$），而训练损失则可以在这些空间中的任意一个中进行度量。尽管由此产生的九种组合在代数上彼此相关，但它们可能在去噪精度和样本质量上带来显著差异。本文解耦了预测目标与损失空间的影响。对于固定的预测目标，我们证明改变损失空间恰好等价于对时间步进行重新加权，并对这种重加权如何影响生成质量给出了启发式分析。随后，我们证明：一个将 $D$ 维含噪输入压缩的秩为 $m$ 的线性瓶颈，会给噪声和速度预测带来 $D-m$ 的不可约平方误差下限，而干净数据预测则可以利用数据的低维结构。将该下限与依赖于预测目标的误差转换相结合，可以得到关于瓶颈容量的不同必要条件。使用 U-（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文解耦了扩散模型中预测目标与损失空间的影响，证明改变损失空间恰好等价于时间步重加权，并从理论上揭示了秩-$m$ 线性瓶颈会使噪声和速度预测存在 $D-m$ 的不可约平方误差下限，而干净数据预测则可利用低维数据结构。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles the effects of prediction targets and loss spaces in diffusion models, proving that changing the loss space is exactly equivalent to timestep reweighting, and showing that a rank-$m$ linear bottleneck imposes an irreducible $D-m$ squared-error floor on noise and velocity prediction while clean-data prediction can exploit low-dimensional data structure.
